definitions.charge_density: rho_c = sum_s(q_s*n_s), summing the complete charged-species set
definitions.electric_field: E = -grad(phi) for the electroquasistatic cases in this contract; inductive terms require a separate field model
definitions.species_momentum_transfer_to_neutral: R_s_to_n = m_s*n_s*nu_sn*(u_s-u_n) for the declared drift/friction collision closure; other momentum-changing reactions must be represented as separately identified source terms
definitions.neutral_momentum_source: S_n_momentum = sum_s(R_s_to_n) + explicitly declared reaction contributions
definitions.equal_opposite_plasma_source: S_s_momentum_reaction = -R_s_to_n for each species and each exchange contribution
definitions.charge_continuity: d(rho_c)/dt + div(J_c) = S_q, where net charge source S_q must be zero for charge-conserving reactions when all charged species are included
definitions.integrated_impulse: I_exchange = integral_over_time integral_over_volume(S_n_momentum dV dt), units N*s

force_transfer_methods.intended_use: Species-resolved or drift-diffusion closure with explicit ion-neutral momentum transfer.
force_transfer_methods.neutral_source: Sum the declared species-resolved momentum-transfer collision operators.
force_transfer_methods.plasma_reaction: Apply the exact equal-and-opposite integrated momentum exchange to the charged-species equations or their reduced momentum balance.
force_transfer_methods.electric_force_ownership: q_s*n_s*E acts on charged species; it is not separately applied as a second neutral momentum source.
force_transfer_methods.forbidden_combination: Do not also apply rho_c*E directly to the neutral flow for the same physical charge-to-neutral momentum transfer.

force_transfer_methods.intended_use: A documented reduced closure where charged-particle momentum storage, flux, pressure/stress and boundary terms are negligible or explicitly absorbed into the closure.
force_transfer_methods.neutral_source: Apply the declared reduced Coulomb-force deposition term only after the reduction assumptions and omitted-term bounds have been qualified.
force_transfer_methods.plasma_reaction: Account for the corresponding reaction through the reduced charged-phase / field / electrode momentum ledger.
force_transfer_methods.electric_force_ownership: rho_c*E may be used as the reduced neutral source only within the declared qualified closure.
force_transfer_methods.forbidden_combination: Do not also apply explicit species drag for the same physical momentum transfer.

exchange_mapping.quantity_to_transfer: space-time integrated impulse over matched control volumes
exchange_mapping.preservation_requirement: The mapping must preserve the global integral of each declared exchange contribution to a case-specific tolerance and report the residual.

reference_kernel.quantity: already-integrated vector impulse in N*s per source cell x time slab
reference_kernel.coverage_policy: all source space-time measure must map; no implicit renormalization or silent loss
reference_kernel.aggregation: deterministic BTreeMap ordering and compensated summation
verification: global vector impulse residual with case-specific absolute-plus-relative tolerances

industry_interoperability.rule: Use conservative mapping for extensive quantities such as forces; use consistent mapping for intensive quantities such as temperature or pressure. The Luminous reference kernel is a narrow impulse-transfer oracle, not a replacement for general multiphysics coupling.

invariants.statement: For every explicitly transferred exchange contribution, the charged-phase and neutral-phase integrated impulses sum to zero within the declared numerical tolerance.
Exactly one momentum-transfer method is selected for each physical exchange path; explicit drag and reduced Coulomb deposition cannot be applied together for the same contribution.
The integrated change in total charge plus boundary current and declared net charge sources closes over the complete charged-species set.
Conservative mapping preserves each exchange integral across nonmatching meshes and time grids.
The declared drag closure must not create net collisional kinetic energy; energy removed from relative drift is accounted as heat or another explicit channel.
A calibrated force-balance result and a control-volume momentum-flux result are alternative observables for cross-checking, not additive thrust terms.
The declared control volume includes pressure traction, viscous traction, inlet/outlet momentum flux, electrode/frame drag and support reactions as applicable.
Unmeasured or unmodelled energy, force and current contributions remain unknown and cannot be silently set to zero.

charge_ledger.sign_convention: Boundary current is positive outward from the declared control volume; volume source is positive net charge production.

momentum_ledger.sign_convention: All vector quantities use the declared inertial frame and right-handed coordinates; neutral gain and charged loss have equal-and-opposite signs for each explicit exchange.

energy_ledger.missing_term_policy: A term that is not measured or modelled is null with a reason; it is never silently interpreted as zero.

thrust_observables.force_balance: Calibrated direct net force with balance calibration, bandwidth, drift, lead/feedthrough parasitics and uncertainty.
thrust_observables.control_volume: Net momentum-flux and traction balance across a declared control volume, with pressure and viscous traction, inlet/outlet momentum flux and frame/electrode forces.
thrust_observables.comparison_rule: Compare independent observables within combined uncertainty; never add them.

source_and_model_boundaries.merlino2d_wire_cylinder_case: Discharge I-V reference only; not a coupled neutral-flow or thrust validation case.
source_and_model_boundaries.wind_tunnel_case: Separate physical-flow and force validation cohort; must preserve its exact geometry, air state and force convention.
source_and_model_boundaries.three_dimensional_dielectric_liquid_fem: Numerical conservation and stability methods are a mathematical precedent only; its liquid-injection physics does not validate atmospheric air-corona transfer.

claim_ceiling: This is a protocol and data-contract proposal. No plasma-neutral solver coupling, numerical conservation result, physical measurement, thrust validation, or SOTA improvement is claimed.
